english_title: 42. Upon Completing a Reading of the Qur'an

phrases.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ أَعَنْتَنِي عَلَى خَتْمِ كِتَابِكَ
phrases.english: 1.O God, You hast helped me complete Your Book,

phrases.arabic: الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَهُ نُوراً وَجَعَلْتَهُ مُهَيْمِناً
phrases.english: 2.which You sent down as a light and appointed as a guardian

phrases.arabic: عَلَى كُلِّ كِتَاب أَنْزَلْتَهُ،
phrases.english: 3.over every book You hast sent down,

phrases.arabic: وَفَضَّلْتَهُ عَلَى كُلِّ حَدِيثٍ قَصَصْتَهُ،
phrases.english: 4.preferring it over every narrative which You hast recounted,

phrases.arabic: وَفُرْقاناً فَرَقْتَ بِهِ بَيْنَ حَلالِكَ وَحَرَامِكَ،
phrases.english: 5.a separator, through which You hast separated Your lawful from Your unlawful,

phrases.arabic: وَقُرْآناً أَعْرَبْتَ بِهِ عَنْ شَرَائِعِ أَحْكَامِكَ،
phrases.english: 6.a Qur'an, through which You hast made plain the approaches to Your ordinances,

phrases.arabic: وَكِتَاباً فَصَّلْتَهُ لِعِبَادِكَ تَفْصِيلاً،
phrases.english: 7.a book, which You hast distinguished very distinctly for Your servants,

phrases.arabic: وَوَحْياً أَنْزَلْتَهُ عَلَى نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ تَنْزِيلاً،
phrases.english: 8.a revelation, which You hast sent down, a sending down, upon Your prophet Muhammad (Your blessings be upon him and his Household).

phrases.arabic: وَجَعَلْتَهُ نُوراً نَهْتَدِي مِنْ ظُلَمِ الضَّلاَلَةِ وَالْجَهَـالَةِ بِـاتِّبَاعِـهِ،
phrases.english: 9.You appointed it a light through following which we may be guided from the shadows of error and ignorance,

phrases.arabic: وَشِفَاءً لِمَنْ أَنْصَتَ بِفَهَمِ التَّصْدِيقِ إِلَى اسْتِمَاعِهِ ،
phrases.english: 10.a healing for him who turns ear toward hearing it with the understanding of attestation,

phrases.arabic: وَمِيزَانَ قِسْطٍ لَا يَحِيفُ عَنِ الْحَقِّ لِسَانُهُ ،
phrases.english: 11.a just balance whose tongue does not incline away from truth,

phrases.arabic: وَنُورَ هُدىً لاَ يُطْفَأُ عَنِ الشَّاهِدِينَ بُرْهَانُهُ،
phrases.english: 12.a light of guidance whose proof is not extinguished before the witnesses,

phrases.arabic: وَعَلَمَ نَجَاةٍ لَا يَضِلُّ مَنْ أَمَّ قَصْدَ سُنَّتِهِ ،
phrases.english: 13.and a guidepost of deliverance, so that he who repairs straightway to its prescription will not go astray

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تَنَالُ أَيْدِي الْهَلَكَاتِ مَنْ تَعَلَّقَ بِعُرْوَةِ عِصْمَتِهِ،
phrases.english: 14.and he who clings to its preservation's handhold will not be touched by the hands of disasters.

phrases.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ فَإذْ أَفَدْتَنَا الْمعُونَةَ عَلَى تِلاَوَتِهِ،
phrases.english: 15.O God, since You hast given us help to recite it

phrases.arabic: وَسَهَّلْتَ جَوَاسِيَ أَلْسِنَتِنَا بِحُسْنِ عِبَارَتِهِ،
phrases.english: 16.and made smooth the roughness of our tongues through the beauty of its expression,

phrases.arabic: فَاجْعَلْنَا مِمَّنْ يَرْعَاهُ حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهِ،
phrases.english: 17.place us among those who observe it as it should be observed,

phrases.arabic: وَيَدِينُ لَكَ  بِاعْتِقَادِ التَّسْلِيْمِ لِمُحْكَمِ آياتِهِ،
phrases.english: 18.serve You by adhering in submission to the firm text of its verses,

phrases.arabic: وَيَفْزَعُ إِلَى الْإِقْرَارِ بِمُتَشَابِهِهِ وَ مُوضَحَاتِ بَيِّنَاتِهِ .
phrases.english: 19.and seek refuge in admitting both its ambiguous parts and the elucidations of its clear signs!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ أَنْزَلْتَهُ عَلَى نَبِيِّكَ
phrases.english: 20.O God, You sent it down upon Your prophet

phrases.arabic: مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ مُجْمَلًا ،
phrases.english: 21.Muhammad (God bless him and his household) in summary form,

phrases.arabic: وَأَلْهَمْتَهُ عِلْمَ عَجَائِبِهِ مُكَمَّلاً،
phrases.english: 22.You inspired him with the science of its wonders to complement it,

phrases.arabic: وَوَرَّثْتَنَا عِلْمَهُ مُفَسَّراً،
phrases.english: 23.You made us the heirs of its knowledge as interpreters,

phrases.arabic: وَفَضَّلْتَنَا عَلَى مَنْ جَهِلَ عِلْمَهُ،
phrases.english: 24.You made us to surpass him who is ignorant of its knowledge,

phrases.arabic: وَقَوَّيْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ لِتَرْفَعَنَا فَوْقَ مَنْ لَمْ يُطِقْ حَمْلَهُ.
phrases.english: 25.and You gave us strength over it to raise us above those not able to carry it.

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ فَكَمَا جَعَلْتَ قُلُوبَنَا لَهُ حَمَلَةً،
phrases.english: 26.O God, just as You hast appointed our hearts as its carriers

phrases.arabic: وَعَرَّفْتَنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ شَرَفَهُ وَفَضْلَهُ،
phrases.english: 27.and made known to us through Your mercy its nobility and excellence,

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ الْخَطِيبِ بِهِ ،
phrases.english: 28.so also bless Muhammad, its preacher,

phrases.arabic: وَ عَلَى آلِهِ الْخُزَّانِ لَهُ،
phrases.english: 29.and his Household, its guardians,

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنَا مِمَّنْ يَعْتَرِفُ بِأَنَّهُ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ ،
phrases.english: 30.and place us among those who confess that it has come from You,

phrases.arabic: حَتَّى لاَ  يُعَارِضَنَا الشَّكُّ فِي تَصْدِيقِهِ
phrases.english: 31.lest doubt about attesting to it assail us,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ يَخْتَلِجَنَا الزَّيْغُ عَنْ قَصْدِ طَرِيقِهِ.
phrases.english: 32.or deviation from its straightforward path shake us!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـهِ،
phrases.english: 33.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنَا مِمَّنْ يَعْتَصِمُ بِحَبْلِهِ،
phrases.english: 34.and make us one of those who hold fast to its cord,

phrases.arabic: وَيَـأْوِي مِنَ الْمُتَشَـابِهَاتِ إلَى حِرْزِ مَعْقِلِهِ،
phrases.english: 35.seek haven from its ambiguities in its fortified stronghold,

phrases.arabic: وَيَسْكُنُ فِي ظِـلِّ جَنَاحِهِ،
phrases.english: 36.rest in the shadow of its wing,

phrases.arabic: وَيَهْتَدِي بِضَوْءِ صَبَاحِهِ،
phrases.english: 37.find guidance in the brightness of its morning,

phrases.arabic: وَيَقْتَدِي بِتَبَلُّجِ إسْفَارِهِ ،
phrases.english: 38.follow the shining of its disclosure,

phrases.arabic: وَيَسْتَصْبِحُ بِمِصْبَاحِهِ،
phrases.english: 39.acquire light from its lamp,

phrases.arabic: وَلَا يَلْتَمِسُ الْهُدَى فِي غَيْرِهِ .
phrases.english: 40.and beg not guidance from any other!

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَ كَمَا نَصَبْتَ بِهِ مُحَمَّداً عَلَماً لِلدَّلَالَةِ عَلَيْكَ،
phrases.english: 41.O God, just as through it You hast set up Muhammad as a guidepost to point to You

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْهَجْتَ  بِآلِهِ سُبُلَ الرِّضَا إلَيْكَ.
phrases.english: 42.and through his Household You hast made clear Your good pleasure's roads to You,

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
phrases.english: 43.so also bless Muhammad and his Household

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلِ القُرْآنَ وَسِيلَةً لَنَا إلَى أَشْرَفِ مَنَازِلِ الْكَرَامَةِ،
phrases.english: 44.and make the Qur'an our mediation to the noblest stations of Your honour,

phrases.arabic: وَسُلَّماً نَعْرُجُ فِيهِ إلَى مَحَلِّ السَّلامَةِ،
phrases.english: 45.a ladder by which we may climb to the place of safety,

phrases.arabic: وَسَبَباً نُجْزَى بِهِ النَّجاةَ فِي عَرْصَةِ الْقِيَامَةِ،
phrases.english: 46.a cause for our being repaid with deliverance at the Plain of Resurrection,

phrases.arabic: وَذَرِيعَةً نُقْدِمُ بِهَا عَلَى نَعِيْمِ دَارِ الْمُقَامَةِ.
phrases.english: 47.and a means whereby we may reach the bliss of the House of Permanence!

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
phrases.english: 48.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَاحْطُطْ بِالْقُرْآنِ عَنَّا ثِقْلَ الْأَوْزَارِ،
phrases.english: 49.lessen for us through the Qur'an the weight of heavy sins,

phrases.arabic: وَهَبْ لَنَا حُسْنَ شَمَائِلِ الأَبْرَارِ
phrases.english: 50.give to us the excellent qualities of the pious,

phrases.arabic: وَاقْفُ بِنَا آثَارَ الَّذِينَ قَامُوا لَكَ بِهِ
phrases.english: 51.and make us follow the tracks of those who stood before You

phrases.arabic: آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ وَأَطْرَافَ النَّهَارِ
phrases.english: 52.in the watches of the night and the ends of the day,

phrases.arabic: حَتَّى تُطَهِّرَنَا مِنْ كُلِّ دَنَسٍ بِتَطْهِيرِهِ،
phrases.english: 53.such that You purifiest us from every defilement through its purification

phrases.arabic: وَتَقْفُوَ بِنَا آثَارَ الَّذِينَ اسْتَضَـآءُوْا بِنُورِهِ،
phrases.english: 54.and makest us to follow the tracks of those who have taken illumination from its light

phrases.arabic: وَلَمْ يُلْهِهِمُ الْأَمَلُ عَنِ الْعَمَلِ فَيَقْطَعَهُمْ بِخُدَعِ غُرُورِهِ .
phrases.english: 55.and whom expectation has not distracted from works, cutting them off through its delusions' deceptions!

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
phrases.english: 56.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلِ الْقُرْآنَ لَنَا فِي ظُلَمِ اللَّيَالِي مُونِساً
phrases.english: 57.and appoint the Qur'an for us an intimate in the shadows of nights

phrases.arabic: وَمِنْ نَزَغَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ وَخَطَرَاتِ الْوَسَاوِسِ حَارِساً،
phrases.english: 58.and a guardian against the instigations of Satan and confusing thoughts,

phrases.arabic: وَلِأَقْدَامِنَا عَنْ نَقْلِهَا إِلَى الْمَعَاصِي حَابِساً،
phrases.english: 59.for our feet an obstruction from passing to acts of disobedience,

phrases.arabic: وَلِأَلْسِنَتِنَا عَنِ الْخَوْضِ فِي الْبَاطِلِ مِنْ غَيْرِ مَا آفَةٍ مُخْرِساً ،
phrases.english: 60.for our tongues a silencer without blight preventing a plunge into falsehood,

phrases.arabic: وَلِجَوَارِحِنَا عَنِ اقْتِرَافِ الآثامِ زَاجِراً،
phrases.english: 61.for our limbs a restrainer from committing sins,

phrases.arabic: وَلِمَا طَوَتِ الْغَفْلَةُ عَنَّا مِنْ تَصَفُّحِ الِاعْتِبَارِ نَاشِراً
phrases.english: 62.and for the scrutiny of heedfulness rolled up in heedlessness an unroller,

phrases.arabic: حَتَّى تُوصِلَ إلَى قُلُوبِنَا فَهْمَ عَجَائِبِهِ
phrases.english: 63.such that You attachest to our hearts the understanding of the Qur'an's wonders

phrases.arabic: وَزَوَاجِرَ أَمْثَـالِهِ الَّتِي ضَعُفَتِ الْجِبَالُ الرَّوَاسِي
phrases.english: 64.and its restraining similitudes which immovable mountains in all their solidity

phrases.arabic: عَلَى صَلاَبَتِهَا عَنِ احْتِمَالِهِ.
phrases.english: 65.were too weak to carry!

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
phrases.english: 66.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

phrases.arabic: وَأَدِمْ بِالْقُرْآنِ صَلَاحَ ظَاهِرِنَا،
phrases.english: 67.and through the Qur'an make permanent the rightness of our outward selves,

phrases.arabic: وَاحْجُبْ بِهِ خَطَراتِ الْوَسَاوِسِ عَنْ صِحَّةِ ضَمَائِرِنَا،
phrases.english: 68.veil the ideas of confusing thoughts from the soundness of our innermost minds,

phrases.arabic: وَاغْسِلْ بِهِ دَرَنَ قُلُوبِنَا وَعَلاَئِقَ أَوْزَارِنَا،
phrases.english: 69.wash away the dirt of our hearts and the ties of our heavy sins,

phrases.arabic: وَاجْمَعْ بِهِ مُنْتَشَرَ أُمُورِنَا،
phrases.english: 70.gather our scattered affairs,

phrases.arabic: وَأَرْوِ بِهِ فِي مَوْقِفِ الْعَرْضِ عَلَيْكَ ظَمَأَ هَوَاجِرِنَا،
phrases.english: 71.quench the thirst of our burning heat in the standing place of the presentation to You,

phrases.arabic: وَاكْسُنَا بِهِ حُلَلَ الْأَمَانِ يَوْمَ الْفَزَعِ الْأَكْبَرِ فِي نُشُورِنَا.
phrases.english: 72.and clothe us in the robes of security on the Day of the Greatest Terror at our uprising!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 73.God, bless Muhammad and his Household

phrases.arabic: وَاجْبُرْ بِالْقُرْآنِ خَلَّتَنَا مِنْ عَدَمِ الْإِمْلَاقِ،
phrases.english: 74.and through the Qur'an redress our lack - our destitution in poverty

phrases.arabic: وَسُقْ إِلَيْنَا بِهِ رَغَدَ الْعَيْشِ وَ خِصْبَ سَعَةِ الْأَرْزَاقِ،
phrases.english: 75.drive toward us the comforts of life and an abundance of plentiful provisions,

phrases.arabic: وَجَنِّبْنَا بِهِ الضَّرَائِبَ الْمَذْمُومَةَ وَ مَدَانِيَ الْأَخْلَاقِ،
phrases.english: 76.turn aside blameworthy character traits and base moral qualities,

phrases.arabic: وَاعْصِمْنَا بِهِ مِنْ هُوَّةِ  الكُفْرِ وَدَوَاعِـي النِّفَاقِ
phrases.english: 77.and preserve us from the pit of unbelief and the motives for hypocrisy,

phrases.arabic: حَتَّى يَكُوْنَ لَنَا فِي الْقِيَامَةِ إلَى رِضْوَانِكَ وَجِنَانِكَ قَائِداً
phrases.english: 78.such that the Qur'an may be for us at the resurrection a leader to Your good pleasure and Your gardens,

phrases.arabic: وَلَنَا فِي  الدُّنْيا عَنْ سَخَطِكَ وَتَعَدِّي حُدُودِكَ ذَائِداً،
phrases.english: 79.for us in this world a protector against Your displeasure and transgressing Your bounds

phrases.arabic: وَلِمَا عِنْدَكَ بِتَحْلِيلِ حَلَالِهِ وَ تَحْرِيمِ حَرَامِهِ شَاهِداً.
phrases.english: 80.and for what is with You a witness by its declaring lawful the lawful and its declaring unlawful the unlawful!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 81.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

phrases.arabic: وَهَوِّنْ بِالْقُرْآنِ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ عَلَى أَنْفُسِنَا كَرْبَ السِّيَاقِ،
phrases.english: 82.and through the Qur'an make easy for our souls at death the distress of the driving,

phrases.arabic: وَجَهْدَ الْأَنِينِ، وَتَرادُفَ الْحَشَارِجِ
phrases.english: 83.the effort of the moaning, and the succession of the rattling,

phrases.arabic: إذَا بَلَغَتِ ألنُّفُوسُ التَّراقِيَ وَقِيلَ مَنْ رَاق
phrases.english: 84.'when souls reach the throats' (ref.75:26) "and it is said, 'Where is the enchanter"? (75:27)';

phrases.arabic: وَتَجَلَّى مَلَكُ الْمَوْتِ لِقَبْضِهَا مِنْ حُجُبِ الْغُيُوبِ،
phrases.english: 85.when the angel of death discloses himself to seize them from behind the veils of unseen things,

phrases.arabic: وَرَمَاهَا عَنْ قَوْسِ الْمَنَايَا بِأَسْهُمِ وَحْشَةِ الْفِرَاقِ،
phrases.english: 86.letting loose at them from the bow of destinies the arrows of the terror of lonesome separation,

phrases.arabic: وَدَافَ لَهَا مِنْ ذَعَافِ الْمَوْتِ كَأْساً مَسْمُومَةَ الْمَذَاقِ،
phrases.english: 87.and mixing for them from sudden death a cup poisoned to the taste;

phrases.arabic: وَدَنَا مِنَّا إلَى الآخِرَةِ رَحِيلٌ وَانْطِلاَقٌ،
phrases.english: 88.and when departure and release for the hereafter come close to us,

phrases.arabic: وَصَارَتِ الْأَعْمَالُ قَلَائِدَ فِي الْأَعْنَاقِ،
phrases.english: 89.works become collars around the necks,

phrases.arabic: وَكَانَتِ الْقُبُورُ هِيَ الْمَأْوَى إِلَى مِيقَاتِ يَوْمِ التَّلَاقِ.
phrases.english: 90.and the graves become the haven until the appointed time of the Day of Encounter!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 91.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي حُلُولِ دَارِ البِلَى
phrases.english: 92.make blessed for us the arrival at the house of decay

phrases.arabic: وَطُولِ الْمُقَامَـةِ بَيْنَ أَطْبَـاقِ الثَّـرى،
phrases.english: 93.and the drawn out residence between the layers of the earth,

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلِ الْقُبُورَ بَعْدَ فِرَاقِ الدُّنْيَا خَيْرَ مَنَازِلِنَا،
phrases.english: 94.appoint the graves, after separation from this world, the best of our waystations,

phrases.arabic: وَافْسَحْ لَنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي ضِيقِ مَلاَحِدِنَا،
phrases.english: 95.make roomy for us through Your mercy the narrowness of our tombs,

phrases.arabic: وَلا تَفْضَحْنَا فِي حَاضِرِي الْقِيَامَةِ بِمُوبِقَاتِ آثامِنَا،
phrases.english: 96.and disgrace us not among those present at the Resurrection through our ruinous sins!

phrases.arabic: وَارْحَمْ بِالْقُرْانِ فِيْ مَوْقِفِ الْعَرْضِ عَلَيْكَ  ذُلَّ مَقَامِنَا،
phrases.english: 97.Through the Qur'an have mercy upon the lowliness of our station at the standing place of presentation to You,

phrases.arabic: وَثَبِّتْ بِهِ عِنْدَ اضْطِرَابِ جِسْرِ جَهَنَّمَ
phrases.english: 98.make firm the slips of our feet during the shaking of the bridge across hell

phrases.arabic: يَوْمَ الْمَجَازِ عَلَيْهَـا زَلَلَ أَقْدَامِنَا،
phrases.english: 99.on the day of passage over it,

phrases.arabic: وَنَوِّرْ  بِهِ قَبْلَ الْبَعْثِ سُدَفَ قُبُورنا،
phrases.english: 100.illuminate the darkness of our graves before the Uprising,

phrases.arabic: وَنَجِّنَا بِهِ مِنْ كُلِّ كَرْبٍ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
phrases.english: 101.and deliver us from every distress on the Day of Resurrection

phrases.arabic: وَشَدَائِدِ أَهْوَالِ يَوْمِ الطَّامَّةِ
phrases.english: 102.and from the hardships of terrors on the Day of Disaster!

phrases.arabic: وَبَيِّضْ وُجُوهَنَا يَوْمَ تَسْوَدُّ وُجُوهُ الظَّلَمَةِ
phrases.english: 103.Whiten our faces on the day when the faces of wrongdoers are blackened

phrases.arabic: فِي يَوْمِ الْحَسْرَةِ وَالنَّدَامَةِ،
phrases.english: 104.during the Day of Regret and Remorse,

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ لَنَا فِي صُدُورِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وُدّاً،
phrases.english: 105.appoint love for us in the breasts of the faithful,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تَجْعَلِ الْحَيَاةَ عَلَيْنَا نَكَداً.
phrases.english: 106.and make not life for us troublesome!

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَ رَسُولِكَ
phrases.english: 107.O God, bless Muhammad, Your servant and Your messenger,

phrases.arabic: كَمَا بَلَّغَ رِسَالَتَكَ، وَصَدَعَ بِأَمْرِكَ، وَنَصَحَ لِعِبَادِكَ.
phrases.english: 108.just as He delivered Your message, executed Your command, and counselled Your servants!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ نَبِيَّنا صَلَواتُكَ عَلَيْهِ
phrases.english: 109.O God, make our Prophet (Your blessings be upon him

phrases.arabic: وَعَلَى آلِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَقْرَبَ النِّبِيِّينَ مِنْكَ مَجْلِساً،
phrases.english: 110.and his Household) on the Day of Resurrection the nearest of the prophets to You in seat,

phrases.arabic: وَأَمْكَنَهُمْ مِنْكَ شَفَاعَةً، وَأَجَلَّهُمْ عِنْدَكَ قَدْراً،
phrases.english: 111.the ablest of them before You with intercession, the greatest of them with You in measure,

phrases.arabic: وَأَوْجَهَهُمْ عِنْدَكَ جَاهَاً.
phrases.english: 112.and the most eminent of them with You in rank!

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، وَشَرِّفْ بُنْيَانَهُ،
phrases.english: 113.O God, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, ennoble his edifice,

phrases.arabic: وَعَظِّمْ بُرْهَانَهُ، وَثَقِّلْ  مِيزَانَهُ،
phrases.english: 114.magnify his proof, make weighty his balance,

phrases.arabic: وَتَقَبَّلْ شَفَاعَتَهُ وَقَرِّبْ وَسِيلَتَهُ،
phrases.english: 115.accept his intercession, bring near his mediation,

phrases.arabic: وَبَيِّضْ وَجْهَهُ، وَأَتِمَّ نُورَهُ،
phrases.english: 116.whiten his face, complete his light,

phrases.arabic: وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ، وَأَحْيِنَا عَلَى سُنَّتِهِ،
phrases.english: 117.and raise his degree! Make us live according to his Sunna

phrases.arabic: وَتَوَفَّنَا عَلَى مِلَّتِهِ، وَخُذْ بِنَـا مِنْهَاجَـهُ،
phrases.english: 118.make us die in his creed, take us on his road,

phrases.arabic: وَاسْلُكْ بِنَا سَبِيلَهُ، وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ أَهْلِ طَاعَتِهِ،
phrases.english: 119.make us travel his path, place us among the people who obey him,

phrases.arabic: وَاحْشُرْنَا فِي زُمْرَتِهِ،
phrases.english: 120.muster us in his band,

phrases.arabic: وَأَوْرِدْنَا حَوْضَهُ، وَاسْقِنَا بِكَأْسِهِ.
phrases.english: 121.lead us to up his pool, and give us to drink of his cup!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 122.And bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: صَلاةً تُبَلِّغُهُ بِهَا أَفْضَلَ
phrases.english: 123.with a blessing through which You wilt take him to the most excellent

phrases.arabic: مَا يَأْمُلُ مِنْ خَيْرِكَ وَفَضْلِكَ وَكَرَامَتِكَ
phrases.english: 124.of what He hopes of Your good, Your bounty, and Your generosity!

phrases.arabic: إِنَّكَ ذُو رَحْمَةٍ وَاسِعَةٍ وَ فَضْلٍ كَرِيمٍ.
phrases.english: 125.You art Possessor of boundless mercy and generous bounty.

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْزِهِ بِمَا بَلَّغَ مِنْ رِسَالَاتِكَ
phrases.english: 126.O God, repay him for Your messages which he delivered,

phrases.arabic: وَأَدَّى مِنْ آيَاتِكَ وَنَصَحَ لِعِبَادِكَ
phrases.english: 127.Your signs which he passed on, the good counsel he gave to Your servants,

phrases.arabic: وَجَاهَدَ  فِي سَبِيلِكَ أَفْضَلَ مَا جَزَيْتَ
phrases.english: 128.and the struggle he undertook in Your way, with the best You hast repaid

phrases.arabic: أَحَداً مِنْ مَلائِكَتِكَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ وَأَنْبِيَائِكَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ الْمُصْطَفَيْنَ.
phrases.english: 129.any of Your angels brought nigh and Your prophets sent out and chosen!

phrases.arabic: وَالسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الطَّاهِرِينَ
phrases.english: 130.And upon him and his Household, the good, the pure, be peace,

phrases.arabic: وَرَحْمَةُ الله وَبَرَكَاتُهُ.
phrases.english: 131.God's mercy, and His blessings!
